en.topic_title: In Hong Kong, mourning a stray dog killed in mainland China means walking a fine line
en.topic_summary:
Outside a commercial building in Causeway Bay, one of Hong Kong’s busiest shopping districts, a column of people carrying umbrellas and flowers wrapped around the block. For hours, mourners waited in the rain so they could pay their respects to Wang Wang, a stray dog who was killed by five boys in mainland China.



People wait in line to lay down flowers for Wang Wang, on July 25, 2026. Photo: James Lee/HKFP.



Holding a bouquet of white chrysanthemums, Brian patiently waited his turn to cram
